title: Counit identity for the inverse-image/pullback comparison
statement: Fix composable scheme isomorphisms $Z\xrightarrow{h}W\xrightarrow{k}V$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], completed coefficients and an object $N\in D^b_c(V,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Let $C_{k,\bullet}$ be the strict quotient tower used in the definition of $Lk^*N$, and identify $M=Lk^*N$ with $R\lim C_{k,\bullet}$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-weil-derived-limit, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Let $h^*C_{k,\bullet}$ be the tower obtained by applying the finite pullback levelwise, and let $u_{h,C_k}:h^{-1}C_{k,\bullet}\to h^*C_{k,\bullet}$ be its termwise unit map, whose components send $x$ to $x\otimes1$ [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison, lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Write $\epsilon_{C_k}:\Delta R\lim C_{k,\bullet}\to C_{k,\bullet}$ and $\epsilon_{h^*C_k}:\Delta R\lim h^*C_{k,\bullet}\to h^*C_{k,\bullet}$ for the derived-limit counits on strict towers, each given by a K-injective tower resolution $q:C_\bullet\to I_\bullet$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex] as $[q]^{-1}$ composed with the ordinary limit-cone map $\Delta\lim I_\bullet\to I_\bullet$, the normalization of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. If $\eta_{h,k,N}:F_{h,E}F_{k,E}N\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim h^*C_{k,\bullet}$ is the comparison used in [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] and $\kappa^h_M:h^{-1}M\to F_{h,E}M$ is the specified inverse-image/pullback comparison [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], then, under $M=R\lim C_{k,\bullet}$, $$\epsilon_{h^*C_k}\circ\Delta(\eta_{h,k,N}\circ\kappa^h_M)=u_{h,C_k}\circ h^{-1}(\epsilon_{C_k})$$ as morphisms of strict quotient towers from $\Delta h^{-1}M$ to $h^*C_{k,\bullet}$. Thus the counit image of $\eta_{h,k,N}\circ\kappa^h_M$ is the termwise map $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ applied to the counit tower, before any realization or reduction.
